remarks: Exceptional opportunity to own over 23 acres of prime hunting and recreational land on Route 394 in Randolph, NY! This impressive parcel offers approximately 1,400 feet of road frontage, providing excellent visibility and access while still delivering the privacy and natural setting outdoor enthusiasts crave. With abundant wildlife habitat and a beautiful rural backdrop, this property is ideal for hunting, exploring, or creating your own peaceful retreat. A roughly 150’ x 150’ area may offer potential for a building site, while the majority of the land is located within designated wetlands, making this a unique property for those who appreciate nature and conservation-style acreage. Conveniently located near Randolph, I-86, Allegany State Park, Ellicottville, and Salamanca, this land offers the perfect blend of seclusion and accessibility. Buyers are not permitted to walk the property without their agent.
